comments.text:
Welcome to Paraguay! 🇵🇾 Here, a legal minimum wage of 3,044,000 guaranies (about $535) has to stretch across bus fares, cooking gas, lunch, rent and everything in between — while a visitor paying in dollars sees bargain after bargain. From a crowded morning bus in Asunción to the immense Itaipú Dam and a shared round of tereré, this is real life in Paraguay, told through the numbers behind it.

We would love to know: where are you watching from? 🌍 Drop your city or country in the comments — and if you live in Paraguay, tell us which of these prices surprised you most.

Thanks for watching! Subscribe to Global Journey 88 for another country, another paycheck, and another real-life story.
